blocked_faults.network_delay: Docker Desktop/WSL kernel lacks the netem traffic-control qdisc; the approved pod-wide probe failed before injection.
blocked_faults.packet_loss: Uses the same unavailable netem qdisc, so no duplicate probe was run.

excluded_runs.m2-control-traffic-surge-002: Interrupted incomplete export; not usable as a complete multimodal control.
excluded_runs.m2-traffic-surge-frontend-001: Workload completed, but telemetry export did not complete before a long unobserved gap and backend retention expiry.
excluded_runs.m2-control-pod-failure-004: Views completed, but its supervisor was deliberately stopped before fault; a host restart then changed the environment. Do not use as the matched control.

limitations: Known-trace API retrieval is not proof of every original span ingested.
Source invalid timestamp spans are retained in canonical and excluded from RE2 with loss counts.
One valid run per fault type does not establish reproducibility or provide a sufficient training set.
Network delay and packet loss require a Docker Desktop/WSL kernel with the netem traffic-control qdisc before formal experiments can run.
